text.tspan: Q: Which stadium's maximum attendance rate is more than double the
Balmoor stadium's highest attendance rate? Give the stadium names.

svg.text: Full schema — 4 tables (stadium shown) + 3 example rows each

text.tspan: Stadium_ID | Location | Name | Capacity | Highest | Lowest | Average

svg.text: singer, concert and singer_in_concert are given in the same form
the sheet is not commentary — it is part of the required output

text.tspan: K1 reference time unrecorded → anchor at query time: strftime('%Y','now')
K3 1 lb = 0.45 kg · 1 inch = 25 mm · 1 mile = 1.609344 km
K4 "difference between A and B" → ABS(A − B) unless the direction is fixed
… 11 conventions in total, none taken from the dev split

svg.text: appended to the system prompt · the dev split is never read
— pure rules, no LLM, re-runs every round
C1 output alignment: SQL columns match declarations
C2 consistency: a premise rewrites data, not filters
C3 grounding: tables, columns and literals exist in the DB
C4 anchors: every derived column declares its frame
C5 anchor ↔ SQL: a declared "now" appears in the SQL
C6 ratio hint: a rate is asked, but nothing is divided → FAILED
solid frame = always on · dashed frame = optional check · ✓ = passed or not applicable
a failed check re-opens the decision — it never supplies the answer
